activity.notes: Michael the Brave became ruler of Wallachia in 1593 and was displaced from effective rule during the Polish-backed installation of Simion Movila in autumn 1600. Sources differ in the precise old-style/new-style accession and displacement day conventions, so ATLAS preserves secure year-level boundaries rather than fabricating a single exact day. Romania is not used as the polity because the modern Romanian state did not yet exist.

sources.title: 430 de ani de la inceputul domniei in Tara Romaneasca a lui Mihai Viteazul — AGERPRES
sources.citation_text: AGERPRES, citing the Romanian Academy's Istoria romanilor, places the beginning of Michael's Wallachian rule in 1593 and describes the collapse of his three-principality rule in 1600.
